facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus lived during the Late Cretaceous (early Maastrichtian) in Alberta, Canada.
facts.quote: Dromiceiomimus is a genus of ornithomimid theropod from the Late Cretaceous (early Maastrichtian) of Alberta, Canada.

facts.statement: Nicholls and Russell cast doubt on the validity of Dromiceiomimus in 1981, arguing that limb proportions were insufficient to distinguish it from other ornithomimids.
facts.quote: In a 1981 publication, however, Nicholls and Russell cast doubt on the validity of Dromiceiomimus and though keeping it distinct from Ornithomimus argued that the limb proportions might be insufficient to distinguish ornithomimid taxa from each other.

facts.statement: Makovicky et al. claimed there is no statistical support for distinguishing Dromiceiomimus from Ornithomimus and synonymized it with Ornithomimus edmontonicus.
facts.quote: In the second edition of the Dinosauria, Makovicky et al. claimed that there is no statistical support for the distinction of Dromiceiomimus from Ornithomimus, and synonymized it with Ornithomimus edmontonicus Sternberg 1933.

facts.statement: Some authors, including Longrich, continued to treat Dromiceiomimus as a valid genus distinct from Ornithomimus.
facts.quote: However, a few authors continued to treat Dromiceiomimus as valid, and Longrich (2008, 2014) treated ROM 840 (holotype of Struthiomimus samueli) as a distinct species of ornithomimid related to Ornithomimus.

facts.statement: In 2018, McDonald and Currie rejected the synonymization of Dromiceiomimus with Ornithomimus, citing significant differences in thighbone/shinbone ratios.
facts.quote: In 2018, Ian McDonald and Philip John Currie rejected the conclusions by Makovicky and colleagues. They showed that the thighbone/shinbone ratio of specimen UALVP 16182, found in 1967 by Richard Fox and referred to Dromiceiomimus, differed significantly from that of Ornithomimus edmontonicus.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus was a fast bipedal runner that resembled a modern running bird.
facts.quote: Dromiceiomimus era un rápido corredor bípedo, que se asemejaba a un ave corredora actual.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus measured approximately 3.5 meters in length and weighed between 100 and 150 kilograms.
facts.quote: Dromiceiomimus medía aproximadamente 3,5 metros de largo, con un peso estimado de 100 y 150 kilogramos.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus possessed long hind legs, large eye sockets, and a toothless beak.
facts.quote: Presentaban largas patas traseras, grandes cuencas oculares y un pico desdentado.

facts.statement: It is believed that Dromiceiomimus was warm-blooded and likely had primitive feathers to stay warm.
facts.quote: se cree que fue de sangre caliente y probablemente tenía un plumaje primitivo para mantenerse caliente.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus was one of the fastest dinosaurs, capable of reaching speeds of 70 kilometers per hour to escape predators like Gorgosaurus.
facts.quote: Hicieron a Dromiceiomimus uno de los dinosaurios más rápidos, que podía volar 70 kilómetros por hora para escapar de grandes predadores como Gorgosaurus.

facts.statement: Ornithomimids had large brains for dinosaurs, though some paleontologists suggest these were dedicated to movement coordination rather than high intelligence.
facts.quote: El tamaño del cerebro de los ornitomímidos eran grandes para un dinosaurio, pero esto no es necesariamente signo de gran inteligencia, algunos paleontólogos piensan que las grandes porciones del cerebro estaban dedicadas a la coordinación de los movimientos.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus was presumably omnivorous and would eat small animals if the opportunity arose.
facts.quote: Presumiblemente, Dromiceiomimus comió incluso pequeños animales si tenía la oportunidad y era omnívoro.

facts.statement: Its forelimbs were very long with three slender, equal-length fingers bearing long straight claws that could form a right angle with the forearm.
facts.quote: Las patas delanteras eran muy largas, con tres finos y largos dedos del mismo largo que llevaban largas garras rectas y podían formar un ángulo recto con el antebrazo.

facts.statement: Adult Dromiceiomimus had long feathers on its forelimbs used for sexual courtship.
facts.quote: En los animales adultos, las patas delanteras estaban provistas de largas plumas para el cortejo sexual.

facts.statement: Russell renamed Ornithomimus samueli as the second species of Dromiceiomimus, Dromiceiomimus samueli.
facts.quote: Russell also synonymized Struthiomimus ingens with Dromiceimimus brevitertius. He renamed Ornithomimus samueli into a second Dromiceiomimus species: Dromiceiomimus samueli.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus samueli is recognized as a subdivision or species within the genus.
facts.quote: subdivision: Dromiceiomimus samueli Parks 1928

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus had a short neck and back, with the spine length before the pelvis being shorter than the combined length of the hind leg even without the toes.
facts.quote: La especie tiene un cuello y un dorso bastante cortos, la longitud de la espina antes de la pelvis es menor que la longitud combinada de la pata trasera, incluso sin los dedos de los pies.

facts.statement: The transition point between the front and rear tail vertebrae in Dromiceiomimus occurs before the fourteenth vertebra.
facts.quote: El punto de transición entre las vértebras de la cola delantera y trasera se encuentra antes de la decimocuarta vértebra.

facts.statement: The foot claws of Dromiceiomimus were narrow when viewed from the bottom.
facts.quote: Las garras del pie son angostas en la vista plantar.

facts.statement: The humerus of Dromiceiomimus was slender, with its upper width being less than one-fifth of the bone's length.
facts.quote: El húmero es delgado con un ancho superior que es menor que el quinto que la longitud del hueso.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus possessed a more robust spine with a heavier tail base and a short back compared to Struthiomimus.
facts.quote: Dromiceiomimus tiene una columna vertebral más robusta con una base de cola más pesada y espalda corta.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus had a notably short neck, which made its elongated and pointed skull appear even more prominent despite the subtle difference.
facts.quote: El hecho de que el cuello es bastante corto es particularmente llamativo porque el cráneo se ve más alargado y puntiagudo, aunque la diferencia es sutil.

facts.statement: The skull of Dromiceiomimus was very elongated.
facts.quote: El cráneo de Dromiceiomimus es muy alargado.

facts.statement: The toothless lower jaw of Dromiceiomimus was elongated and very thin.
facts.quote: La mandíbula inferior desdentada es alargada y muy delgada.

facts.statement: The jaw articulation of Dromiceiomimus allowed front-to-back movement, suggesting its beak could easily cut plant material while staying sharp through wear.
facts.quote: Debido a que la articulación de la mandíbula permite un movimiento de desplazamiento de la parte delantera a la trasera, el pico que probablemente se mantuvo afilado por el desgaste podría cortar fácilmente el material de la planta.

facts.statement: The vertical bite force of Dromiceiomimus was likely small.
facts.quote: La fuerza de mordida vertical habrá sido pequeña.

facts.statement: It is debated whether the differences between Dromiceiomimus brevitertius and Dromiceiomimus samueli are distinct enough to warrant separate species status.
facts.quote: La diferencia entre D. brevitertius y D. samueli es menos clara.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that the heavier skull of Dromiceiomimus samueli might be due to allometry rather than a true species difference, as its holotype is larger.
facts.quote: La primera diferencia puede deberse a la alometría ya que el holotipo de D. samueli es más grande.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus originated in the early Maastrichtian, distinguishing it from Ornithomimus species which originated in the late Maastrichtian.
facts.quote: Las especies Ornithomimus reales también se pueden distinguir por origen, se originan a partir de Mastrichtiano tardío, mientras que Dromiceiomimus en el temprano.

facts.statement: The vertebral column of Dromiceiomimus consists of ten cervical vertebrae, thirteen dorsal vertebrae, six sacral vertebrae, and approximately thirty-five tail vertebrae.
facts.quote: La columna vertebral de Dromiceiomimus tiene diez vértebras cervicales, trece vértebras, seis vértebras sacras y alrededor de treinta y cinco vértebras de la cola.

facts.statement: The cervical vertebrae feature a low spine with a frontal opening in the vertebral arch.
facts.quote: Las vértebras cervicales tienen un espolón bajo con un hueco frontal en el arco vertebral.

facts.statement: The vertebrae are tall, spindle-shaped, and possess higher spinous projections.
facts.quote: Las vértebras son altas, en forma de huso y con proyecciones espinosas más altas.

facts.statement: Starting from the fourteenth tail vertebra, the vertebrae extend while their spinous knobs shorten and boot-shaped spines lengthen to cover two-thirds of the front vertebral body, rigidifying the tail.
facts.quote: Desde la decimocuarta vértebra de la cola, las vértebras se extienden, sus botones de espinas se acortan y sus comillas en forma de bota; las protuberancias de las vértebras delanteras se vuelven más largas y comprenden dos tercios de la longitud del cuerpo vertebral frontal, de modo que la cola se rigidiza.

facts.statement: The forelimb is long due to an elongated right humerus and a very long hand, with the middle finger being a notably large part.
facts.quote: El brazo es largo, tanto por un húmero derecho particularmente alargado como por una mano muy larga, especialmente la mano media es una parte notablemente grande.

facts.statement: The first metacarpal bone is approximately the same length as the second, unlike in most theropods where it is much shorter.
facts.quote: El primer hueso metacarpiano tiene aproximadamente la misma longitud que el segundo, en lugar de ser mucho más corto que con la mayoría de los terópodos.

facts.statement: The three fingers are nearly equal in length and bear long, fairly straight claws.
facts.quote: También los tres dedos son casi iguales en longitud y llevan garras largas, bastante rectas.

facts.statement: The foot digit formula is 2-3-4-0-0.
facts.quote: La fórmula de las patas de los dedos es 2-3-4-0-0.

facts.statement: The midfoot is strongly elongated and arctometatarsalian, with the third metatarsal bone so strongly pinched at the top that it is forced off the front surface.
facts.quote: El mediopié es fuertemente elongado y arctometatarsiano, con un tercer hueso metatarsiano tan fuertemente pellizcado en la parte superior que es forzado desde la superficie frontal.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus is considered one of the fastest dinosaurs, with some estimates comparing it to an ostrich suggesting a maximum speed exceeding 70 kilometers per hour.
facts.quote: Dromiceiomimus para convertirse en uno de los dinosaurios más rápidos cuya velocidad máxima, de acuerdo con algunas estimaciones comparándolo con el avestruz podría haber superado los 70 kilómetros por hora.

facts.statement: The genus Dromiceiomimus was named by Russell in 1972.
facts.quote: PBDB name: Dromiceiomimus (genus), Russell 1972

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus belongs to the parent group Ornithomimidae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Ornithomimidae

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus is classified within the family Ornithomimidae.
facts.quote: Family: Ornithomimidae

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus is classified under the class Reptilia.
facts.quote: Class: Reptilia

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus lived during the Maastrichtian stage, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Canadian paleontologist Dale Russell suggested that these animals were entirely carnivorous, feeding on eggs and small animals they could pull from burrows with their long arms.
facts.quote: El paleontólogo canadiense Dale Russell ha sugerido que estos animales eran enteramente carnívoros, alimentándose de huevos y pequeños animales que podían sacar de sus madrigueras con sus largos brazos.

facts.statement: This opinion is still under discussion, as its body shape suggests an adaptation for a partially herbivorous lifestyle.
facts.quote: Esta opinión todavía está en discusión, su forma corporal habría sido adaptada para una forma de vida en parte herbívora.

facts.statement: It could have eaten insects, fruits, eggs, lizards, and small mammals.
facts.quote: Pudo haber comido insectos, frutas, huevos, y lagartos y pequeños mamíferos.

facts.statement: Large eye sockets suggest a highly developed sense of vision, giving the possibility that it was nocturnal.
facts.quote: Las cuencas oculares grandes sugieren un sentido visual muy desarrollado, lo que da la posibilidad que fuera nocturno.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus was placed within Ornithomimidae by Russell.
facts.quote: Dromiceiomimus fue colocado dentro de Ornithomimidae por Russell.

facts.statement: The relationship with other Ornithomimus species is not yet entirely clear.
facts.quote: La relación con las otras especies de Ornithomimus aún no está del todo clara.

facts.statement: Dromiceiomimus samueli has not yet been studied separately.
facts.quote: Dromiceiomimus samueli aún no se ha estudiado por separado.

rejected.quote: The type species, D. brevitertius was originally described as a species of Struthiomimus by William Parks in 1926 on the basis of a partial postcranium, ROM 797, from the Horseshoe Canyon Formation of Alberta, Canada.

rejected.quote: Las garras del pie son delgadas con un fondo hueco. No sirven como armas, pero están optimizadas para minimizar la adherencia con la superficie de la tierra.
